entries.subject: DAMIT 867: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-867.txt. Model 867, version 2016-01-04, pole (196°, 0°), period 31.901 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Original shape table
entries.finding: [Original shape table](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/3320/shape.txt) — counted XYZ vertices and one-based triangle indices.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive models: Model 868: pole (15°, 7°), period 31.9009 h. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 868: pole (15°, 7°), 31.9009 h, version 2016-01-04. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "55.74 km (size-calibrated model)" (akari-acua-v1) implies a diameter of 111.48 km, outside the added Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 31, DAMIT model 868 diameter 103 ± 3 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 868 fitted to 2 occultations). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.

entries.subject: Leukothea whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 13 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.933 at 462 nm, 0.982 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#494845 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 6.6% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 1.5%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
